larry-page.stakeMethod: 389,051,160 Class B shares beneficially owned by Larry Page / (6,679,104,001 Class A and Class B shares + 5,468,478,389 Class C shares outstanding on the April 8, 2025 record date) = 3.20%. Computed, not stated in the filing. Class B only: the proxy ownership table excludes non-voting Class C stock, so any Class C shares Page holds are not counted; if he holds any, his true economic share is higher than this figure. Neither filing discloses his Class C holdings.

mark-zuckerberg.stakeMethod: (141,000 Class A + 342,606,985 Class B beneficially owned) / (2,181,270,402 Class A + 343,179,151 Class B outstanding at April 1, 2025) = 342,747,985 / 2,524,449,553. Both classes have the same economic rights per share; computed from the proxy's class counts, not stated in the filing.

lee-jae-yong.stakeLabel: Samsung Life Insurance and its related parties stake

peter-thiel.stakeMethod: (70,871,556 Class A + 29,128,444 Class B + 335,000 Class F beneficially owned) / (2,262,682,774 Class A + 96,002,664 Class B + 1,005,000 Class F outstanding at the April 11, 2025 record date) = 100,335,000 / 2,359,690,438. The 10-K states the three classes have identical dividend and liquidation rights. Thiel's row contains no options or RSUs (footnote 9). Computed, not stated in the filing.

brian-l-roberts.stakeMethod: (31,639,412 Class A beneficially owned + 9,444,375 Class B) / (3,729,400,000 Class A + 9,444,375 Class B outstanding at the April 8, 2025 record date) = 1.10%. Computed, not stated in the filing. Caveats: his holdings are as of February 28, 2025 while the share counts are as of April 8, 2025; his Class A figure includes 6,726,161 shares under options exercisable within 60 days and 392,106 shares under stock units vesting within 60 days, which are not in the outstanding count; and it includes shares owned by his spouse, a family charitable foundation and family trusts. Cross-check: proxy footnote 8 says that if he converted his Class B into Class A 'he would beneficially own approximately 1% of the Class A common stock.'

tobias-lutke.stakeMethod: (631,611 Class A + 78,918,520 Class B shares owned, controlled or directed) / (1,217,781,463 Class A + 79,265,812 Class B shares issued and outstanding at April 7, 2025) = 79,550,131 / 1,297,047,275. The single Founder Share is ignored. Computed, not stated in the filing.

stephen-a-schwarzman.stakeMethod: 231,924,793 Blackstone Holdings Partnership Units / (729,415,925 shares of common stock outstanding + 439,589,683 Blackstone Holdings Partnership Units owned by limited partners, both as of February 21, 2025) = 19.84%. Computed, not stated in the filing. Basis: Blackstone Inc. common stock plus the partnership units of Blackstone Holdings held by its limited partners (Blackstone personnel and others), which are exchangeable for common stock one-for-one; together these are the whole economic interest in Blackstone Holdings. Caveats: the 10-K's own '51.8% of class' for his units implies a larger unit denominator (about 448 million, probably including unvested units) than the 439,589,683 units it reports as outstanding, and the 10-K does not state that denominator; using its year-end total of 1,221,159,186 vested and unvested shares and units (December 31, 2024) instead would give about 19.0%.

phil-knight.stakeMethod: 35,815,174 shares (Philip Knight's Class B figure in the proxy, which by the proxy's convention counts his 27,479,487 Class A shares as converted into Class B, so it is his total of both classes) / (288,887,752 Class A + 1,188,015,740 Class B shares outstanding on July 9, 2025) = 2.43%. Computed, not stated in the filing. Excludes the 226,750,000 Class A shares owned by Swoosh, LLC (see family) and 521,792 Class A shares owned by his spouse, which he disclaims.

wang-chuanfu.stakeMethod: (513,623,850 A shares + 1,000,000 H shares) / 2,909,265,855 total issued shares at 31 December 2024. Computed, not stated as one figure: the report states the two holdings separately as 17.65% and 0.03% of total issued share capital. Excludes the 3,727,700 A shares held through the E Fund BYD No.1 Assets Management Plan, which the report also leaves out of the 513,623,850.

lei-jun.stakeMethod: (4,068,513,104 Class A + 1,985,666,534 Class B shares in which Lei Jun is interested) / (4,517,510,134 Class A + 20,581,641,676 Class B shares in issue at 31 December 2024). Computed, not stated: the report gives his holdings only as % of each class (90.06% of Class A; 9.65% of Class B via Smart Mobile 8.91%, Smart Player 0.29% and Team Guide 0.45%).

n-r-narayana-murthy.stakeLabel: Infosys promoters and promoter group stake

brian-chesky.stakeMethod: (4,238,762 Class A + 62,917,140 Class B beneficially owned) / (433,034,896 Class A + 185,611,689 Class B outstanding at April 7, 2025) = 67,155,902 / 618,646,585. The 9,200,000 non-voting Class H shares are left out of the denominator because all are held by Airbnb's own wholly-owned subsidiary and the 10-K computes net income per share only for Class A and Class B; including them gives 10.70%. Chesky's row contains no options or RSUs (footnote 1). Computed, not stated in the filing.

michael-saylor.stakeMethod: (378,500 Class A + 19,616,680 Class B) / (249,688,978 Class A + 19,640,250 Class B outstanding at April 22, 2025) = 19,995,180 / 269,329,228. Common stock only; the non-voting preferred stock (8,500,000 Strife and 7,763,888 Strike shares) is excluded. Computed, not stated in the filing. The proxy's own as-converted figure, 'Beneficial Ownership of Class A Stock (% of Class)', is 7.4%.

mike-cannon-brookes.stakeMethod: 48,024,933 Class B shares / (167,238,849 Class A + 96,049,867 Class B outstanding as of September 30, 2025) = 18.24%. Computed, not stated in the filing; both inputs are from the same table and date.

jack-dorsey.stakeMethod: (1,000,000 Class A + 47,844,566 Class B beneficially owned) / (559,548,869 Class A + 60,048,763 Class B outstanding at March 31, 2025) = 48,844,566 / 619,597,632. Class B converts one-for-one into Class A, and the 10-K says holders of both classes are entitled to dividends when declared by the board; the classes differ in votes (one versus ten). Dorsey's row contains no options or RSUs (footnote 3). Computed, not stated in the filing.

david-velez.stakeMethod: (6,379,354 Class A + 931,124,498 Class B beneficially owned) / (3,768,057,942 Class A + 1,050,600,698 Class B outstanding), all as of December 31, 2024 = 937,503,852 / 4,818,658,640. Computed, not stated in the filing. No options or RSUs are included in his row (footnote 2 lists only shares held of record).

david-baszucki.stakeMethod: (8,314,636 Class A beneficially owned − 5,650,889 Class A shares subject to options exercisable within 60 days + 48,293,658 Class B) / (628,477,206 Class A + 48,293,658 Class B outstanding at February 28, 2025) = 50,957,405 / 676,770,864. Options are excluded so the figure counts only shares outstanding; on the SEC beneficial-ownership basis (options added to both numerator and denominator) it would be 8.30%. Computed, not stated in the filing.

vlad-tenev.stakeMethod: (6,907 Class A + 46,638,223 Class B shares beneficially owned by Vladimir Tenev) / (768,174,496 Class A + 115,645,012 Class B shares outstanding on April 7, 2025; zero Class C) = 5.28%. Computed, not stated in the filing. Beneficial ownership includes 565,079 Class B shares held by the Bhatt Family LLC that Tenev votes but in which, the proxy says, he has no economic interest.

eric-yuan.stakeMethod: (83,548 Class A issuable on RSU settlement + 21,620,585 Class B) / (261,833,697 Class A + 42,294,470 Class B outstanding at March 31, 2025 + his 83,548 RSU shares, which SEC rules deem outstanding for his own percentage) = 21,704,133 / 304,211,715. Computed, not stated in the filing.

ben-silbermann.stakeMethod: 38,744,937 Class B shares held by the Benjamin and Divya Silbermann Family Trust / (593,725,910 Class A + 82,494,082 Class B outstanding at the March 26, 2025 record date) = 38,744,937 / 676,219,992. His 6,274 Class A shares are RSUs vesting within 60 days, not outstanding shares, so they are excluded (including them changes the result by less than 0.01 point). Computed, not stated in the filing.

evan-spiegel.stakeMethod: (39,063,540 Class A + 5,862,410 Class B + 123,683,019 Class C shares beneficially owned by Evan Spiegel) / (1,436,495,296 Class A + 22,523,290 Class B + 231,626,943 Class C shares outstanding at December 31, 2024) = 9.97%. Computed, not stated in the filing.
